title: Linear equations and word problems: practice set 2
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 10 questions, 20 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: The sum of two numbers is 50, and one of them is 8 more than the other. What is the larger number?
Solve 4x + 3y = 26 and 2x − y = 8. What is x + y?
Meera is 6 years older than her brother. In 4 years, the sum of their ages will be 40. How old is Meera now, in years?
For what value of k does the system 3x − 2y = 5 and 6x + ky = 7 have no solution?
A worker is paid ₹800 for each day he works and is fined ₹200 for each day he is absent. Over 30 days he receives ₹16,000 in all. On how many days was he absent?
Five years ago, the ages of Anil and Bhavna were in the ratio 3 : 4. Ten years from now, they will be in the ratio 6 : 7. What is Bhavna's present age, in years?
The digits of a two-digit number add up to 11. When the digits are reversed, the new number is 27 more than the original. What is the original number?
How many pairs of non-negative integers (x, y) satisfy 4x + 7y = 100?
A shop charges ₹110 for 2 pens, 3 notebooks and 4 erasers, and ₹130 for 4 pens, 3 notebooks and 2 erasers. What is the total cost, in rupees, of 1 pen, 1 notebook and 1 eraser?
Riya spends exactly ₹300 on apples at ₹15 each and mangoes at ₹24 each, and she buys at least one of each. What is the largest number of fruits she could have bought?
